notes:
Lead inbound via blog post about structured output for ticketing. Prefers self-serve Hosted API but wants quick POC before shipping. Primary contact: CTO (Maya Lin) and Head of Ops (Jonas Reed).

Discovery call 2026-03-01 notes:
- Pain: long ticket triage time, inconsistent agent summaries across channels. Avg handle time ~ 9m, target reduce 30%.
- Wants: structured JSON output (fields: summary, priority, category, suggested KB link, assignee_suggestion). Tool-calling to run internal KB search and attach evidence URL.
- Workloads: low-medium QPS (~10-60 reqs/min during peak), mostly chat->ticket summarization + auto-tagging. Latency SLO: 300-600ms preferred for summary endpoint; willing to accept 1s for complex context.
- Model preferences: open models OK if LLM shows stable structured output. Interested in Redwood model catalog for lightweight quantized variants.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget-conscious; prefers pay-as-you-go with burst tolerance. Interested in Optimize suggestions for batching for peak windows.
- Security: currently no SOC2 but roadmap Q4; requires SSO/SAML, audit logs, retention controls, and a written statement on data handling for Hosted API.
- Quote from CTO: "We need outputs we can reliably parse into fields or else we can't automate routing."

Follow-ups required: send quickstart code + branch of prompt templates, example webhook for tool-calling, suggested request/response schema, sample cost estimate for 10k tokens/month.

poc_scope: 30-day lightweight POC: integrate Hosted API for ticket summarization on subset of channels (email + chat), deliver structured JSON schema, add a demo webhook to call internal KB, measure accuracy/parse-rate and latency during office hours
technical_constraints: No on-prem deployment for now. Must authenticate via SSO for team; need audit log export (JSON) for tickets created via API. Payloads may include up to 8k tokens of conversation context occasionally.
sales_notes:
Good fit for Hosted API self-serve -> quick POC. Upsell path: Optimize + dedicated pool when volume grows. Low touch sales possible but require clear SSO + data handling doc.
AE to confirm price sensitivity and confirm whether they will use Redwood dashboard for token-level analytics.
why_redwood: Job-to-be-done: reliable structured summaries + tool-calling for KB searches with transparent latency and cost. They liked Redwood's focus on structured output, fallback routing, and per-route dashboards.
objections_handled: Explained Hosted API data ingestion practices; provided draft SSO integration steps; clarified model dropbacks and fallback to smaller variants to save cost.
other_notes: Prefer email updates. Wants example of function-calling webhook pattern. Interested in auto-rollout to production if POC parse-rate > 90% and avg latency < 700ms.
